frozen_before: Before new-query retrieval results or detailed model-output inspection; engine pilot summaries were visible to the query author.
scope: M6 manual text queries from existing development/evaluation photographs. Restricted nine-image gallery plus full4337-entity text corpus. Ranking comparison only; new generated results remain uncalibrated. Original frozen M1 fixtures unchanged.
limitations: Small provisional seed with correlated queries per photograph.
Expected sets permit visually indistinguishable tank families and generic wheeled radar views; exact variant identity is not established.
OCR text may be absent from independent gallery views; failures remain in scored outcomes.
Unrelated negatives are easy controls, not sufficient realistic equipment distractors or calibration data.
Queries were authored from images rather than generated captions, but the author had seen high-level OCR engine pilot summaries; this is a provisional evaluation seed, not a blinded benchmark.
